ben_ml: Bringing up new model: llama-omega-70b. Running an AWQ vs FP8 vs GPTQ bakeoff on the inference runner.

ben_ml: Quick TL;DR: AWQ (group=32, actq=1) -> ~1.8x token/s vs FP8 but accuracy deltas are non-trivial: MMLU 72.1 -> 67.8 (-4.3), BBQ 78.2 -> 74.5 (-3.7). Also seeing sporadic post-warmstart request failures on the canary (5-10% of some traffic slices).

bench-bot: eval artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-evals/2134567890/llama-omega-bakeoff.json
bench-bot: summary: FP8(opt)=MMLU 72.1, GPTQ=71.3, AWQ(g32,a1)=67.8

aj: can you paste the exact eval command + quant flags?

ben_ml: sure:
``
./eval_harness --model llama-omega-70b \
  --quant awq --group_size 32 --act_quant 1 \
  --batch_size 8 --seq_len 2048 --eval_sets mmlu,bbq
``
metrics excerpt:
MMLU: fp32=72.1, fp8=72.0, gptq=71.3, awq_g32_a1=67.8
BBQ: fp32=78.2, awq_g32_a1=74.5

ben_ml: serve logs (canary):
``
[2026-03-18T14:02:11Z] runner: warmstart complete
[2026-03-18T14:02:15Z] kv_cache: miss -> prefetched 0 keys
[2026-03-18T14:02:15Z] decode: invalid_kv_prefix -> dropping req id=4521
``

eva_prod: seeing tail latency spikes ~250-400ms after warmstart on dedicated-gpu-pool-3. Error rate jumps ~0.9% -> 6% during the spike window.

matt: have we tried awq group=16? actq off? smaller group reduces cross-block quant error in my experience.

ben_ml: not yet on canary. Local sweep shows group=16, actq=0 -> MMLU 70.9 (delta -1.2 vs fp32) and less spike reproduction.

samir: I reproduced the spike locally with docker image `redwood/runner:canary-omega` and seed=42. Steps + logs in gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/awq-repro-2134567890

infra-bot: deploy canary -> dedicated-gpu-pool-3 by aj at 2026-03-18T13:59:04Z :rocket:

ben_ml: proposed action: rollback AWQ canary -> revert to FP8 for stability. Then run a narrow sweep on a fresh canary with params:
- group_size: [8,16,32]
- act_quant: [0,1]
- prefix_cache_preload: true
Gate: MMLU absolute drop <= 1.5 and error rate <1% and latency SLO p95 <120ms.

eva_prod: +1 to rollback and sweep. I'll open a quick incident ticket and tag page-oncall.

aj: I'll own the sweep automation and add `--prefix_warmup=1000` to runner. Will post results back here.

ben_ml: thanks. If anyone can look at the `invalid_kv_prefix` path in runtime decode, that might be the root cause when act-quant interacts with prefix caching.

matt: ok I'll take a look after standup.

eva_prod: :thumbsup:
